intro: Big Thursday energy: Kansas Cash took a historic L (all $63 of it!) and still found time to yell at the market to close. Legend behavior.

items.caption: A record-setting day! The biggest loss of his trading career, a staggering sixty-three whole dollars. Diamond hands, cardboard wallet, zero regrets.
items.quote: $SPY $TSLA today was the most I’ve ever lost in the market. All $63 dollars gone fam!

items.caption: When the chart gets too spicy, our guy goes straight to management and demands they shut the whole thing down.
Four letters, one mood. Poetry for the $LPTH holders.
